title: Explicit-method stress-neutral 0.3 export package; pure projection without Current authentication

items.description: The member's case section (PhysicsGeometry) and its traversal flag.

PhysicsGeometry.description: D-5 section bases (DEL-05-03 Design section-bases-and-timoshenko.md section 2.3): the authored OD, nominal wall, mill tolerance and corrosion allowance; the nominal section (stiffness, metal mass, nominal stress family), the reduced section (wall minus mill tolerance and corrosion allowance; reduced stress family), the pressure bore of the reduced wall, and the member's shear model. A realized arc's entry, and only an arc's, carries member_kind = realized_arc (section 2.5) and is Euler-Bernoulli under either contract. The readers rederive the walls, radii and the Timoshenko factor; the leaves are prepared values.

PhysicsSectionAnnulus.description: One section basis's annulus: wall, inner radius and the prepared area, second moment, polar moment and section modulus leaves.

PhysicsPressureBore.description: The pressure bore: the reduced wall's inner radius and bore area (pressure thrust and end caps; contents mass).

PhysicsBeamTheory.description: The straight member's shear model (section 3.1): Euler-Bernoulli, or the energy-matched annular Timoshenko factor kappa_E with its shear area A_s = kappa_E * A_n on the nominal section. A realized arc is always Euler-Bernoulli.

PhysicsStressMaximumCoverage.description: Per-basis stress-maximum coverage: the nominal entry, then the reduced entry (the order is bound by the readers).

value.description: Canonical JCS numeric value; either received zero sign is represented as +0. Actual received sign is retained in source_value_bits.

source_value_bits.description: Actual received finite IEEE754 binary64 value bits. For zero, source_row.value is canonical +0 and this field retains +0/-0; for nonzero, bits decode exactly to source_row.value. Bound by the package hash; exact received bits checked when original source is supplied.

PreviewPhysicsContractEvidence.description: Closed preview-physics-2 statement (T0R S1 §5): per-case straight-member maximum enclosures, coverage, support attribution and intensified-measure inputs, plus one gate per model combination. Binding to rows is checked by the readers; no engineering qualification.
